CustomSql.SqlQuery:
-- Select from the first table, which has the 'YYYY-MM-DD' format
SELECT
    -- Correct format for "2025-08-18" is '%Y-%m-%d'
    CAST(date_parse(forecast_extracted, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE) AS forecast_extracted, 
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(commodities, '-', ' ')) = 'lpg' THEN 'LPG'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(commodities, '-', ' ')) = 'crb' THEN 'CRB Index'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(commodities, '-', ' ')) = 'rapeseed oil' THEN 'Rapeseed'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(commodities, '-', ' ')) = 'brent crude oil' THEN 'Brent'
        ELSE ARRAY_JOIN(
            TRANSFORM(
                SPLIT(REPLACE(commodities, '-', ' '), ' '),
                word -> UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2))
            ),
            ' '
        )
    END AS Commodity,
    reason_type,
    reasons AS summaries,
    countries
FROM
    shippingbi.te_commodity_summary

UNION ALL

-- Select from the second table, which has the 'dd/mm/yyyy' format
SELECT
    -- Correct format for "18/08/2025" is '%d/%m/%Y'
    CAST(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE) AS forecast_extracted,
        CASE
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE("id", '-', ' ')) = 'lpg' THEN 'LPG'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE("id", '-', ' ')) = 'crb' THEN 'CRB Index'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE("id", '-', ' ')) = 'rapeseed oil' THEN 'Rapeseed'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE("id", '-', ' ')) = 'brent crude oil' THEN 'Brent'
        ELSE ARRAY_JOIN(
            TRANSFORM(
                SPLIT(REPLACE("id", '-', ' '), ' '),
                word -> UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2))
            ),
            ' '
        )
    END AS Commodity,
    reason_type,
    opinion AS summaries,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS countries
FROM
    shippingbi.all_news_overviews_today_llm
WHERE
    opinion IS NOT NULL
    AND date IS NOT NULL
